plain.自动子 Agent 模型不得超过 Terra High；显式 Sol 或更高模型: Automatic subagent models cannot exceed Terra High; explicit Sol or stronger models are denied.
plain.自动子 Agent reasoning_effort 最高为 high。: Automatic subagent reasoning_effort cannot exceed high.
plain.显式模型无法证明不超过 Terra High，按 fail-closed 策略拒: The explicit model cannot be proven within the Terra High ceiling and is denied fail-closed; use gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, or omit the explicit model.
plain.PreToolUse 输入无法解析，按 fail-closed 策略拒绝自动子: PreToolUse input could not be parsed; automatic subagent dispatch is denied fail-closed.
plain.PreToolUse Hook 异常，按 fail-closed 策略拒绝自动子: PreToolUse Hook failed; automatic subagent dispatch is denied fail-closed.

plain.Approval 过期时间必须晚于当前时间: Approval expiry must be later than the current time
plain.这是工作流级授权记录，不是 Codex 平台或操作系统权限边界: This is a workflow-level approval record, not a Codex platform or operating-system permission boundary
plain.基线、项目、任务、环境或操作不一致时必须失败关闭: Fail closed when the baseline, project, task, environment, or operation does not match
plain.Approval 仓库与 Project Profile 不一致: The Approval repository does not match the Project Profile

plain.时间必须包含时区: The timestamp must include a time zone
plain.缺少受支持的完整性字段: is missing a supported integrity field
plain.项目治理状态默认必须保存在业务仓库外: Project-governance state must remain outside the business repository by default
plain.目标目录不是 Git 仓库:: Target directory is not a Git repository:
plain.禁止把受管根目录本身作为替换目标: The managed root itself cannot be used as a replacement target

fstring.f\"JSON 顶层必须是对象: {path}\": f"The JSON top level must be an object: {path}"

plain.Evidence 仓库与 Project Profile 不一致: The Evidence repository does not match the Project Profile
plain.Evidence 只证明记录范围内的观察，不授予 commit/push/dep: Evidence proves only observations within its recorded scope and grants no commit, push, deploy, restart, or data-write authority
plain.仓库指纹变化后必须重新判断 freshness: Freshness must be reassessed after the repository fingerprint changes

plain.execution-state 与 Finalization 仓库不一致: execution-state does not match the Finalization repository
plain.本检查器不会执行 commit/push/deploy/restart 或生产操: This checker does not commit, push, deploy, restart, or perform production operations
plain.Push 只有显式动作读回证据才能标记为已确认，本地 upstream ref: Push can be confirmed only by explicit action readback evidence; a local upstream ref cannot replace remote readback
plain.未记录 readback evidence 的外部动作必须保持 not-conf: External actions without recorded readback evidence must remain not-confirmed

plain.Codex 跨项目技术助手 V5.0 项目治理运行时: Codex Cross-Project Engineering Assistant V5.0 project-governance runtime

plain.反馈仅用于人工评估，不自动修改模型、预算或路由规则: Feedback is for human evaluation only and never changes models, budgets, or routing rules automatically
